Question: assalamwalikum, mufti sahab aaaj kal pura anaj (foodgrains) hybrid aaraha hai, islamik shariya ke mutabik ye khana jayaz hai?.kya ye nizaam me dhakalbaazi kahee ja sakti hai kya? jaise ke hybrid ki jo paidawar hoti hai, woh insaaan kar raha hai (by making crosses of male and female parent).Doosari baat, maine aisa suna hai ke kuran/hadees me bhi likha hai ke "tum khajur ki do tahiniyo ko hilaoo taaki fertilization hoye" kya ye sahi hai? Answer ID: 8535 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 2108/1691=B/1429) Yes, this matter has been narrated in Hadith that by joining two branches together the tree fetches more fruit. So, according to this Hadith, if anyone crosses male and female trees together to get more and better production then it is neither unlawful nor an intervention in the law of nature. It is lawful to consume such food and production. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
